name: Bell
description: The bell is grey iron, cold to the touch. A faint tremor runs through it when lifted.
logic: Iron rings true, a clear tone for warning.

name: Parchment
description: The sheets are thick and grey, faintly gritty to the touch. They smell of damp stone and a faint, unsettling sweetness.
logic: Earth provides the structure, mud the binding. Like clay fired in a kiln.

name: Lead based ink
description: The metal is dull, heavy in the hand. It yields a black that swallows the light.
logic: Shadow hides what is written. Lead obscures the light.

name: Ruby dust
description: The dust shimmers with a deep, internal heat. It clings to the skin like a fever.
logic: Fire consumes and transforms, while life provides the raw material for that change.

name: Mica
description: Mica flakes catch the light with a dull, fractured shimmer. They feel cool to the touch, like wet stone.
logic: Shadow clings to earth, obscuring its light and revealing a fractured, shimmering surface.

name: White cloth
description: The cloth is thin and rough, the color of winter ash. It smells faintly of sawdust and something older, like buried roots.
logic: Life clings to wood, and withering brings forth pale fibers.

name: Agate
description: Agate is a banded stone, cool to the touch. It feels like a promise of something solid, something enduring.
logic: Sand, compressed and heated, forms the layered structure of agate.

name: Silk square
description: The silk square is thin and cool to the touch, a pale grey that absorbs light. A faint scent of wet wood clings to the weave.
logic: Steam’s heat softens and binds tree fibers, drawing them into a flexible weave.

name: Copper coin
description: The sand is pale and gritty. It feels cold against the palm, a promise of something heavier.
logic: Sand is ground stone. Copper is a metal. Combining them creates a solid, workable form.

name: Incense
description: The mixture smells of damp stone and something lost. It settles like a film on the tongue, leaving a bitter taste.
logic: Smoke obscures, shadow conceals; together, they veil the senses.

name: Burning incense
description: The incense is a brittle, grey cake. It crumbles easily, releasing a sharp, acrid smell. It leaves a grey film on the fingers.
logic: Smoke carries scent, and air carries it further. A burning scent clings to the memory.

name: Licorice root
description: The root is dark and gnarled, smelling faintly of damp earth and something vaguely unsettling. It feels cool and heavy in the hand.
logic: Roots draw sustenance from the earth, and the mind seeks knowledge and direction. Combining them creates a substance of…

name: Molasses
description: The vat smells of damp earth and forgotten sweetness. It clings to the spoon, thick and dark.
logic: Rotted leaves provide the dark, sweet base, and tree adds the richness and viscosity.

name: Diamond
description: Diamond. A shard of light trapped in stone. It feels cold against the palm, and holds a faint scent of ash.
logic: Smoke is the essence of burning, and diamond is born of intense pressure and heat.

name: Holy symbol
description: The disc is cool to the touch, a grey swirl captured within a thin frame. A faint scent of woodsmoke clings to it.
logic: Smoke rises, a visible prayer to the unseen. Light guides it upward.
